about_the_game:
Playtesters Wanted

We’re opening a closed playtest and are looking for testers.

If you want access:

  • Join our Discord:

  • Check the playtest channel for instructions and key distribution

  • Feedback and bug reports will be handled directly on Discord

Spots are limited and access is manual.

Descend into dark, ever-changing cultist dungeons in this VR roguelite—and fight to uncover the secrets that bind orcs and Dragonians in uneasy peace. Mine resources, gather intel, and enact personal vendettas against enemy disciples, then return to your village to forge gear and plan your next epic descent.

EVER-SHIFTING DUNGEONS

No two runs are alike. Procedural chambers force you to choose: rescue a hostage, hunt a disciple, mine ore, or seek warlock intel—each choice shifting risk and reward.

VR BLACKSMITHING

Experience immersive VR blacksmithing: smelt ore, hammer weapon blanks on the anvil and slot elemental gems. Every crafted weapon is uniquely yours, with permanent sockets, mission enchantments, and in-dungeon power surges.

WEAPONS & TOOLS

Use axes, bows, or swords—upgrade them with gems and swap gear between runs to adapt and discover rare variants.

BLOODLUST & RISK

Embrace near-death for power: the lower your health, the stronger you become. Let a serpent bite you to gain poison strikes, then unleash deadly attacks.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features frequent fantasy combat against enemy creatures. Combat includes mild, non-graphic blood visual effects when enemies are hit. There is no dismemberment, gore, or graphic violence. The game does not depict sexual content, sexual assault, self-harm, or drug use.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 / RX 580 - 6GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • VR Support: OpenXR, SteamVR, Quest 2, Quest 3, Valve Index
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: A VR roguelite dungeon-crawler where you dive into Dragonian cultist lairs—mine resources, gather intel, and settle vendettas with axes, bows, and more—then return to your cozy village to forge gear and plan your next descent.
